limits: Exact date windows taken from Measure Dates table for ASC_1 through ASC_19 measures present in facility header. No assumption that row Year applies to all measures.
The eight self-reported measures use 2025 dates, while four claims measures end in 2024. ASC-11 is voluntary under the publisher topic guidance.
Footnotes, performance categories, total-case applicability, confidence/interval meaning, scale and missing-value domains require exact release dictionary and pinned raw-value qualification.
